PHYTOTOUCH: LIVING PLANT BIO-ACOUSTIC SYNTHESIZER

An Accessible Cyber-Physical Interface Bridging Plant Electrophysiology, Human Touch Capacitance & Vedic Saptak Audio Synthesis
NIRMAN LAB 2026–2027
01 INTRODUCTION & BACKGROUND

Plants are living electrophysiological organisms with continuous ionic xylem-phloem micro-currents. When a human touches a leaf, parallel human body capacitance (~120 pF) alters the local dielectric field.

PhytoTouch captures these sub-microsecond bio-capacitance fluctuations using an ESP32 relaxation oscillator, transmitting real-time telemetry over Web Serial to an in-browser Web Audio DSP engine. It transforms living flora into an expressive, interactive acoustic instrument tuned to Vedic Saptak swaras.

Key Innovation: Zero-damage leaf surface sensing combined with low-latency client-side Web Audio DSP (< 12 ms touch-to-sound response).
02 PROBLEM STATEMENT

Modern urban environments suffer from severe nature-deficit disorder and elevated psychological stress. Meanwhile, existing laboratory bio-potential instrumentation presents insurmountable barriers:

  • Prohibitive Cost: Scientific electro-diagnostic rigs cost ₹60,000 to ₹2,50,000, locking out schools and public spaces.
  • Invasive Electrodes: Needle probes puncture leaf cuticle, causing tissue necrosis and cellular death within 48 hours.
  • Artificial Interaction: Standard synthesizers are cold plastic keys lacking emotional connection to living ecosystems.
Goal: Engineer an ultra-affordable (< ₹900), non-invasive, open-access bio-acoustic workstation for therapy, education, and artistic expression.

10 CONCLUSION & FUTURE ROADMAP

Conclusion: PhytoTouch establishes a scalable, scientifically grounded paradigm for inter-species interaction. By bridging plant electrophysiology with browser Web Audio DSP, it renders nature's micro-dynamics accessible to therapy, education, and art without expensive laboratory hardware.

  • Wireless Mesh (ESP-NOW): Multi-tree synchronized forest soundscapes.
  • Edge ML Diagnostics: Detecting xylem embolism & drought stress.
  • Solar Self-Powered Pods: Outdoor autonomous botanical sound parks.
05 METHODOLOGY & SIGNAL PIPELINE
🌿 1. Non-Destructive Leaf Interface Copper Foil + Silicone Clips
▼ Micro-current discharge (Tau = R × C)
⚡ 2. ESP32 Relaxation Oscillator Internal Touch Engine @ 8 MHz Clock
▼ 4-Sample Moving Average & Dynamic Thresholding
🔌 3. UART Web Serial Bridge Non-blocking 115,200 baud ASCII Frame Stream
▼ Native Chromium Web Serial Port Handshake
🎶 4. Web Audio DSP Polyphonic Engine 432 Hz Sacred Flora Tuner • P31 Oscilloscope

Grounding Plane: Stainless steel soil probe sinks 99% of 50Hz ambient power grid electromagnetic interference.
